Axiom: A reported symptom is an entry point, never the class. Every finding MUST be classified BEFORE any edit: bug vs spec-defect, action category (direct-fix / spec-update / task-reopen), the full problem class and the blast radius. Triviality of a fix is confirmed by the blast-radius probe, never by self-assessment. A fix applied without this classification is a symptom patch, not SDD.
